source.title: Photocurrents of cone photoreceptors of the golden‐mantled ground squirrel.

method: electrophysiology: spectral sensitivity of membrane current recorded from individual cones in small pieces of retina
quote: Spectral sensitivity measurements showed two classes of cones with peak sensitivities at about 520 and 435 nm.
note: Abstract only: the free copy fetched (PubMed Central page, OpenAlex submittedVersion) is a landing page with the abstract and reference list; the scanned full text was not in the copy read. The title calls the animal the golden-mantled ground squirrel. Two cone classes; the rod (peak near 500 nm) is a separate class of cell.
